name: Chamois Cleaner

features.text: Helps avoid scratches created by a dirty chamois.
Helps extend the life of a chamois

description: A concentrated formula designed to clean, soften, and protect chamois. Helps loosen embedded dirt particles to minimize the likelihood of scratching painted surfaces. Soaking chamois in a solution of this cleaner and water will help leave the chamois soft and clean for the next use.
application: DIRECTIONS: 1) Add 2-3 ounces of product to each gallon of water in a bucket. 2) Let chamois soak in solution. 3) Wring out chamois and rinse with clean water before using. NOTE: For heavily soiled chamois, clean with product diluted 8 parts water to 1 part product, rinse chamois with water, then soak in solution as directed above.
review: Spelling corrected from the old sheet: Chamios -> Chamois
